notes.connector_scope: total_connectors reflects the 40 plugins recorded in connectors.json; the Discover catalog contains 90+ available plugins, but only 11 had measurable organization adoption in the last 30 days.
notes.least_used_definition: Among connectors WITH adoption, internal-comms (rank 11, 2 users) is the least used. Connectors with zero users are listed separately in zero_adoption_connectors.
notes.data_integrity: No values are fabricated; user counts come directly from the Plugins Discover 'Most used' view and project data from the Projects Organization view.
notes.privacy: Per-project detail (titles, descriptions, creators) is not published in this public repo. Only aggregate counts (total public projects and a projects-by-category breakdown) are shared.
